name: kanban-agent
description: SQLite-backed kanban board for multi-agent workflows. Parallel implementers each run in isolated git worktrees. Planner, implementer, reviewer, QA, and overseer coordinate via shared DB. QA validates through execution and screenshots only.

hooks.command: sqlite3 -column -header .kanban/kanban.db "SELECT changed_at, table_name, record_id, field, old_value, new_value FROM change_log ORDER BY changed_at DESC LIMIT 5;"
